title: Sweden's Instrument of Government says all public power proceeds from the people
summary: Sweden's Instrument of Government says all public power proceeds from the people.
body: Article 1 of the Instrument of Government says all public power in Sweden proceeds from the people, and it continues by founding Swedish democracy on the free formation of opinion and on universal and equal suffrage. The source says: "Basic principles of the form of government Art 1 All public power in Sweden proceeds from the people." The Instrument of Government is the text compiled under that name. Public power proceeding from the people is the opening rule.
